def solve_nqueens(n):
    """Solve N-Queens using backtracking with constraint propagation."""
    solution = []
    cols = set()
    diag1 = set()  # row - col
    diag2 = set()  # row + col
    
    def backtrack(row):
        if row == n:
            return True
        for col in range(n):
            if col in cols or (row - col) in diag1 or (row + col) in diag2:
                continue
            cols.add(col)
            diag1.add(row - col)
            diag2.add(row + col)
            solution.append(col)
            if backtrack(row + 1):
                return True
            solution.pop()
            cols.remove(col)
            diag1.remove(row - col)
            diag2.remove(row + col)
        return False
    
    backtrack(0)
    return solution

solution = solve_nqueens(21)
print("Solution:", solution)
print("Length:", len(solution))

# Verify the solution
def verify(sol):
    n = len(sol)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            if sol[i] == sol[j]:
                return False, f"Same column: rows {i},{j}"
            if abs(sol[i] - sol[j]) == abs(i - j):
                return False, f"Same diagonal: rows {i},{j}"
    return True, "Valid!"

valid, msg = verify(solution)
print(f"Verification: {msg}")
